notes.title: The Isle of Cats Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517731/d7726f8384b29ad49c4bf9321d392c2ecbfa9742.png[/img]

Today’s patch addresses a number of issues reported by the community, along with a variety of general improvements.

[h2]Community Reported[/h2]
[list]
[*] Corrected several instances of mistranslation in Spanish.
[*] Updated several prompts for clarity, including Catnip and Catcall (and all similar effects) as well as prompting around discarding Lesson cards.
[*] Resolved a number of issues with the add friend flow.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several bugs where challenge and Rescue rules modifiers were not functioning as intended.
[*] Re-worded portions of the Rescue scoring screen for greater clarity.
[*] Corrected several softlocks and game crashes, including several which occurred in Rescues with certain modifiers.
[/list]

[h2]UX/UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted highlight positioning, shape and size throughout the game, including an issue where rare treasure highlights could become obtrusive.
[*] Resolved overlapping textures, objects and text.
[*] Corrected some visual issues with the auto-camera.
[*] Corrected numbering of tiles on the beach.
[*] Moved opponents’ boats closer to player’s, enabling better visibility when zoomed fully out. Opponent boats are still off-screen when zoomed far enough in.
[/list]

[h2]Gamepad[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain Anytime cards couldn’t be played during Jump In windows while using a gamepad.
[*] Improved gamepad functionality on certain prompts, including the friends list and chat.
[*] You can now correctly use the bug report modal with gamepad (though we hope you don’t need to!).
[*] Hotkeys to open certain prompts now work correctly while you have the chat window open.
[*] Mobile
[*] Added UI for precise tile adjustments to account for difficulty with manually dragging.
[*] Adjusted mobile cat tile tray for ease of use with certain cards.
[*] Fixed an issue where the front end menu could fail to load.
[*] Resolved several minor UI issues such as incorrect fonts and overlapping icons.
[*] Fixed an issue where a blown-up card could reappear after dismissing it.
[*] The leaderboards should now properly display usernames.
[*] Treasure tiles should no longer overlap no matter what order they’re drawn in.
[*] Screen size now properly adjusts when folding a foldable device.
[/list]

[h2]AI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a case where the AI would play slowly.
[*] Resolved an AI crash which could occur when the Extended Family and Whale modifiers were enabled in Rescue.
[*] Solo games will now properly show your sister’s score when skipping the scoring count-up animation.
[*] Your sister has been caught cheating and no longer gains points from Public Lessons in Solo mode.
[*] The easy AI will now go a little lighter on drafting Lesson cards.
[*] The AI now overall makes more natural decisions about drafting Lesson and Rescue cards.
[/list]

[h2]Front-End[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added confirmation and clarification of text for reporting other players.
[*] Corrected issue of miscounted Lessons in Player History.
[*] Rescue page now reloads when Rescue timer hits zero.
[*] Updated Treasure Trove Challenge text for clarity.
[*] Corrected spots where non-English text could overflow its borders at certain resolutions.
[*] You should now be able to change your avatar and color when joining a match even if you’re the last player to join and the game auto-starts.
[/list]

If you run into trouble while playing, please let us know via in-game feedback, or by dropping a line to Support@DireWolfDigital.com so we can help, and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/direwolfdigital]join our player community on Discord![/url]

Thanks for playing [i]The Isle of Cats[/i]!
